title: equisetum × litorale var. vulgare
intro: Equisetum × litorale var. vulgare, commonly known as Horsetail, is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the Equisetaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including urinary tract problems and kidney stones, due to its diuretic and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Equisetum × litorale var. vulgare include promoting wound healing, reducing inflammation, and improving bone health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include silicon, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
